I don't want to push you without checking availability, so wanted to propose two alternative slots that should avoid overlap:

- Fri Apr 21, 09:00 AM PT — full console walkthrough + 30 min API Q&A
- Mon Apr 24, 01:00 PM PT — condensed console (45m) + API follow-up workshop

Can you confirm which (if either) works for your team? If neither, feel free to drop a few windows and we'll prioritize adjusting internal schedules.

I've attached a brief preflight checklist so your engineers can bring the right access (API keys, service account, sample dataset). Also copied Camila and Ben — Camila will run the console portion and Ben will lead the API live lab if we go ahead.
